description: Header file defining a templated C++ class TlsEnabled for managing TLS configuration in WebSocket connections, including certificate handling, TLS context setup, and verification.

classes.name: TlsEnabled
classes.description: A templated class providing TLS setup and certificate management for WebSocket clients.

methods.name: setCertFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the TLS certificate.

methods.name: setKeyFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the TLS private key.

methods.name: setCAFileNames
methods.description: Sets the list of CA certificate filenames.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes TLS setup, including setting the TLS context handler.

methods.name: setAuthenticationState
methods.description: Determines if TLS connection is authenticated based on connection error codes.

methods.name: onTlsInit
methods.description: Creates and configures the SSL context for TLS connections.

methods.name: loadCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Loads CA certificates into the SSL context.
